install_point: after all Stage-A initialization, immediately before workload exec (never before no_new_privs)
change_control: docs/seccomp-derivation/policy.md section 5: NO UNDOCUMENTED SYSCALL EXPANSION.
limitations: aarch64 mapping derived from asm-generic/unistd.h (Linux kernel). Numbers are authoritative for 64-bit aarch64. Native aarch64 trace verification has NOT been performed. Some syscalls are name-mapped (chmod->fchmodat, link->linkat, symlink->symlinkat, rename->renameat2) because aarch64 has no legacy syscall equivalents.
derivation_notes: x86_64 arch_prctl (TLS segment register) removed — not applicable on aarch64. x86_64 vfork removed — glibc on aarch64 uses clone(CLONE_VM|SIGCHLD) internally. access->faccessat, dup2->dup3, mkdir->mkdirat, poll->ppoll, readlink->readlinkat, unlink->unlinkat — aarch64 has no legacy syscalls, glibc uses *at() variants. chmod->fchmodat, link->linkat, symlink->symlinkat, rename->renameat2 — same reason. Numbers from asm-generic/unistd.h, NOT from the x86_64 table.

changelog.reason: Initial aarch64 derivation from QEMU user-mode emulation. arch_prctl/vfork excluded; *at() variants used.

changelog.syscall: socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, getsockopt, setsockopt, getsockname, getpeername
changelog.reason: v0.2 networking prerequisites: loopback proxy communication.

changelog.syscall: chmod(fchmodat), close_range, copy_file_range, fadvise64, fstatfs, lgetxattr, link(linkat), listxattr, rename(renameat2), statfs, statx, symlink(symlinkat), umask, uname
changelog.reason: Toolchain variants observed on native x86_64 Ubuntu 24.04 / kernel 6.8. Mapped to aarch64 asm-generic equivalents. unlinkat already in aarch64 allowlist (not re-added). Numbers verified against include/uapi/asm-generic/unistd.h.
changelog.security_impact: Same as x86_64: all tier1 filesystem/metadata operations confined to the mount namespace.
changelog.evidence: aarch64 numbers derived from kernel headers, NOT from native aarch64 trace (trace not yet performed).

changelog.reason: Phase 10 (v0.2 Step 4) dependency-installation workflow: mirrors the x86_64 allowlist.json change (69 -> 70). pip's adjacent_tmp_file calls os.fsync before the atomic wheel rename; the install aborts when fsync is EPERM'd. aarch64 number 82 (asm-generic). bind/clock_nanosleep/mremap/readlinkat/rmdir stay denied - proven tolerated under real seccomp on x86_64; aarch64 requires native trace verification.
changelog.security_impact: fsync is durability-only: no privilege, capability, namespace/network/filesystem-boundary escape. Socket-domain filtering unaffected. clone/clone3 remain denied (aarch64 glibc uses clone internally, not clone3, and clone is not allowlisted).
changelog.evidence: x86_64 native real-seccomp test 2026-08-23; aarch64 number from asm-generic/unistd.h (fsync=82).
